recap.text: Beatrice is in the Bahamas with an ex-boyfriend. Carl ended their relationship by phone a few days before the Transformation. Carl wears her pink shoes, and her cat is on the stairs.

Carl records that Beatrice has a tattoo of a Persian cat, Princess Chonkalot, on her lower back that he called a stoned Ewok. Donut calls the tattoo a masterpiece. Donut uses a vote to get a photograph of Beatrice in a bikini on her ex-boyfriend Brad's lap. Donut puts the photo beside her cat tree.

Beatrice survives the collection in a Seattle parking garage with Brad and four dentists. She lives in a native camp called New Queen Anne where she sings to a half-feral stray named Ferdinand and wears his scratches on her face and arms. Two bounty hunters cut into her tent, and a woman named Lexis shoots her way in to take her.

Beatrice survives the initial collection and Odette removes her from the planet to blackmail Borant for a higher revenue share. Beatrice appears as a holo in a red gown and tall shoes, looking pale and drugged. She tells Carl that men with hyena faces found her after pirates wiped her memory. She asks Carl why he is not wearing pants, and Odette makes her disappear.

Beatrice uses her boyfriend's Facebook account to block a coworker named Sally. Beatrice tells the boss Sally is stalking him and has a friend send the boss photographs of a stranger from the internet. Sally is fired that day, which Beatrice and her friends think is the funniest thing ever.

beats.headline: The Bahamas, with her ex
beats.text: Subject is in the Bahamas with her ex-boyfriend, whom she did not mention was coming, and she posted the photograph. Carl ended it by phone a few days before the Transformation, which, as timing goes, was impeccable. She is not on my stairs. Her cat is. Her family's breeding line is. Her shoes are, on his feet, and they are pink. That is the file. I have never had so little to say about anyone, and I resent it.
beats.gist: Beatrice is in the Bahamas with an ex-boyfriend; Carl's pink shoes are on his feet.

beats.headline: A cat on her lower back
beats.text: Entered into the record, by Carl, in a basement under the Over City: Beatrice's tattoo is a faded Persian cat on her lower back, surrounded by uneven wisps. The cat is Princess Chonkalot, Donut's long-dead grandmother and Beatrice's childhood cat. Carl considers it a stoned Ewok, and once said so aloud, along with a remark about who gets to see it. That was a mistake. Donut rules it a masterpiece and an exception to the rule against tattoos.
beats.gist: Carl records that Beatrice has a faded Persian cat tattoo on her lower back.

beats.headline: A photograph from a box
beats.text: The first box Donut's followers voted on contains a small framed photograph of Beatrice, taken straight from her Instagram: bikini, laughing, on the lap of her ex-boyfriend Brad. It is the photograph over which Carl ended things. Donut is delighted and shows it to Mordecai, Mongo and the barkeep, who strokes the glass. Carl finds that it no longer bothers him, and shrugs deliberately at the ceiling. Donut puts it on the table beside her cat tree. Mongo hisses at it.
beats.gist: Donut finds a photograph of Beatrice in a bikini on Brad's lap and shows it to others.

beats.headline: New Queen Anne
beats.text: Subject is alive. She survived the collection in a Seattle parking garage with Brad and four dentists, and lives now in a native camp called New Queen Anne, where everyone works but her. She has taken in a half-feral stray she calls Ferdinand, and sings to him at night that she should have let him in. Her face and arms are covered in his scratches. Two bounty hunters cut into her tent; one of them knows her name. Then a woman named Lexis, who works for Odette, shoots her way in behind them and takes her.
beats.gist: Beatrice lives in New Queen Anne with a stray named Ferdinand and is taken by Lexis.

beats.headline: Alive, and off the planet
beats.text: Beatrice survived the initial collection. Bounty hunters were after her, meaning to sell her illegally to Borant, who would have transformed her into a country boss. A very specific one. Odette had her removed from the planet before they found her, then used her to blackmail Borant: the official story will say Borant did something noble, and Odette gets a higher revenue share for the rest of the crawl. The contract was signed in a hurry. The former girlfriend of Crawler Carl is now on her way to the inner system, standing by for a guest appearance.
beats.gist: Beatrice survives the collection and Odette removes her from the planet to blackmail Borant for revenue.

beats.headline: On the couch, as a holo
beats.text: Beatrice, newest full-rights citizen of the Syndicate, appears in a red gown and very tall shoes, much thinner, pale, and by every sign drugged. Her story has holes: pirates came into her tent while she slept, her memory was wiped, and at some market a small alien recognised her and started shouting before she woke among men with hyena faces. She is surprised the cat talks. She asks Carl why he is not wearing pants, and whether he can come to her. He says nope. When he has said goodbye, Odette nods, and she disappears.
beats.gist: Beatrice appears as a holo in a red gown and tall shoes.

beats.headline: Operation: Slut Stomp
beats.text: Report filed by the cat, after the fact. Subject was on her boyfriend's Facebook, notifications and all, because he used one password for everything. A coworker named Sally, a single mother, asked him out. Subject blocked her from his account, told his boss she was stalking him, and had a friend send the boss a stranger's photographs from the internet. Sally was fired that day. Subject and her friends thought it was the funniest thing ever.
beats.gist: Beatrice blocked Sally and had a friend send fake photos to a boss to fire Sally.

relations.note: She knew about him and did not tell Carl
Named for Bea's fake therapist, not for Bea
